fusions.name: Ram With the Rim
fusions.desc: Lowers your head behind the rim of your shell and rams, which deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scree Down the Slope
fusions.desc: Kicks loose a slide of scree down the cone ahead of you, which deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores armour. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +30%).

fusions.name: Plant All Four Feet
fusions.desc: You take 25% less damage for 12 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Purchase on Stone
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
